title: A Theorem on the Syracuse Problem
publication: Proceedings of the Seventh Manitoba Conference on Numerical Mathematics and Computing (Winnipeg, 1977), Congressus Numerantium 20, 553-559

consultation.scope: All seven scanned pages inspected visually, including Sections I-II, Theorems 3-4 and the continued-fraction table. Only original printed text was used; third-party annotations are not evidence.
consultation.remaining: Continued-fraction computation and numerical constants not independently reproduced. A stable institutional copy would be preferable to the public annotated scan.

notes: Excludes nontrivial positive one-circuit cycles through an exponential Diophantine equation, a Baker bound and continued fractions. This is historical input to Paper D's m-cycle programme, not an arbitrary-m exclusion or termination proof. The familiar 1977 citation is the conference year; Lagarias's bibliography dates the proceedings publication to 1978. Record both rather than treating them as separate papers.
